theme: Dark Theme ONLY (Futuristic / Advanced Warfare HUD / JARVIS)

headings.usage: Use for primary titles, section headers, and HUD data points. Ensure tracking-tight or tracking-wider depending on context (wider for small subheadings).

body.usage: Use for body text, numbers, metrics, and terminal/HUD logs.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-md with bg-[#0A1118]/60 and a 1px border of #00F0FF/20 to simulate HUD glass.
visual_enhancers.glow_effects: Use drop-shadows and box-shadows aggressively for active states: shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,240,255,0.4)].
visual_enhancers.corner_cuts: Use clip-path: polygon(10px 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 10px), calc(100% - 10px) 100%, 0 100%, 0 10px) to give containers and buttons an angular, sci-fi military feel.
visual_enhancers.scanlines: Overlay a subtle repeating linear gradient (scanlines) on hero backgrounds or terminal windows.

grids.bento_hud: Use asymmetrical grid layouts (Grid cols-12) for dashboard and hero areas. Leave some empty cells to mimic a de-cluttered HUD.
grids.spacing: Use generous padding inside glass panels (p-6, p-8) and tight gaps (gap-4) between data-dense widgets.

layouts.global: Full width, immersive. Use fixed, transparent navbars with heavy blur. No white backgrounds.
layouts.marketplace: Grid of tools with holographic hover states. Live demo widgets should look like active terminal windows.

motion.interactions: Micro-animations on hover: slight translate-y, border color transition to solid cyan, and glow intensity increase.
motion.page_load: Staggered fade-ins with slight slide-up, mimicking a HUD booting up.
motion.libraries: framer-motion for transitions, react-fast-marquee for data ticker tapes.

3d_libraries.tsparticles: Use for floating digital dust/stars in the deep space background.
3d_libraries.lucide-react: Standard icons, but style them with cyan colors to match the HUD.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over glass panels meets 4.5:1 ratio. Use text-shadow if needed. Do NOT use completely transparent backgrounds under text.
accessibility.focus: Focus states must have a solid 2px outline in Amber (#FFB000).

hero_background.description: Abstract dark background with scattered white and blue particles.

ai_hologram.description: Glowing orbs and digital elements in dark space (JARVIS AI core representation).

cyber_server.description: A very large array of electronic equipment in a room.

component_instructions.buttons: Create a custom Button component using Shadcn but add the sci-fi clip-path and glowing border logic.
component_instructions.cards: Use Shadcn Cards but override classes to be: bg-[#0A1118]/60 backdrop-blur-md border border-[#00F0FF]/20 rounded-none clip-path-corners.
component_instructions.inputs: Shadcn Inputs should have transparent backgrounds, bottom border only or full thin border with focus ring in cyan.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use 'Rajdhani' and 'JetBrains Mono' from Google Fonts in index.html.
Implement TSParticles for the background to give it that interstellar, JARVIS-like environment.
Build the UI to look like an immersive Call of Duty Advanced Warfare HUD: diegetic elements, cyan/amber glowing data points.
Do NOT use pure white backgrounds anywhere. The theme is strictly dark mode (void black).
Apply 'clip-path' polygon styles to buttons and cards to give them angular, futuristic military cuts.
Include 'data-testid' on all interactive elements as per the rules.
Use lucide-react for icons, but render them in cyan (#00F0FF) to match the HUD styling.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container in CSS.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, etc.
